# KONSUMSI ENERGI SECARA BERTANGGUNG JAWAB

Responsible Energy Consumption

(302-1) (302-2) (302-3) (302-4) (POJK51-F.5) (POJK51-F.6) (POJK51-F.7)

Pada tahun 2024, kami telah berhasil mencatat dan menghitung konsumsi energi di seluruh unit usaha kami. Hal ini menjadi langkah maju dalam pengelolaan energi perusahaan, mengingat pada tahun sebelumnya, konsumsi energi dari unit SHS dan LMR belum dapat dilaporkan secara menyeluruh.

Dari hasil pemantauan, kami mencatat bahwa konsumsi energi di unit CPM mengalami peningkatan signifikan sebesar 40,3% dibandingkan tahun sebelumnya. Peningkatan ini sejalan dengan lonjakan kapasitas produksi unit CPM, yang mencapai 4.000 ton per hari sepanjang tahun 2024. Dengan meningkatnya skala produksi, kebutuhan energi yang lebih besar menjadi konsekuensi yang tidak terhindarkan, sehingga optimalisasi efisiensi energi tetap menjadi fokus utama kami dalam operasional yang berkelanjutan.

Pemanfaatan energi terbarukan merupakan cara yang paling signifikan bagi suatu perusahaan jika ingin menurunkan dampaknya secara keseluruhan terhadap lingkungan, terutama dalam rangka menurunkan emisi perusahaan. Sebagai perusahaan yang bergerak di industri pertambangan, pemanfaatan biosolar 30 merupakan langkah konkret yang dapat dilakukan saat ini dalam memulai upayanya untuk melakukan transisi energi. BRMS beserta unit usaha telah menggunakan bahan bakar biosolar B30 untuk kendaraan operasional dan kendaraan sehari-hari seperti dumptruck, articulated dumptruck, manhaul dan light vehicule.

In 2024, we have successfully recorded and calculated energy consumption across all our business units. This is a step forward in the company's energy management, considering that in the previous year, energy consumption from the SHS and LMR units could not be reported comprehensively.

From our monitoring results, we recorded a significant 40.3% increase in energy consumption at unit CPM compared to the previous year. This rise aligns with the surge in unit CPM's production capacity, reaching 4,000 tons per day throughout 2024. As production scales up, higher energy demand becomes inevitable, making energy efficiency optimization a key focus in our sustainable operations.

Utilizing renewable energy is the most significant way for a company to reduce its overall impact on the environment, especially in order to reduce company emissions. As a company engaged in the mining industry, the utilization of biodiesel 30 is a concrete step that can be taken now in starting its efforts to make an energy transition. BRMS and its business units have been using B30 biodiesel fuel for operational and daily vehicles such as dumptruck, articulated dumptruck, manhaul and light vehicle.

Waste Management

(306-1) (306-2) (306-3) (306-4) (306-5) (POJK51-F.13) (POJK51-F.14) (POJK51-F.15)

Dalam industri pertambangan emas, pengelolaan limbah menjadi aspek penting dalam kepatuhan lingkungan dan keberlanjutan operasional. Limbah yang dihasilkan terbagi menjadi limbah operasional dan limbah domestik. Limbah operasional, seperti oli bekas, filter minyak, dan sisa bahan kimia dari perawatan alat berat serta konstruksi kecil, umumnya termasuk limbah B3 (Bahan Berbahaya dan Beracun). Sementara itu, limbah domestik berasal dari aktivitas sehari-hari di proyek, seperti perkantoran, kantin, dan perumahan pekerja, yang sebagian besar berupa sampah organik dan anorganik. Untuk meminimalkan dampak lingkungan, pengelolaan limbah dilakukan dengan menerapkan prinsip 3R (Reduce, Reuse, Recycle). (306-1)

Prosedur Standar (SOP) pengelolaan limbah baik B3 maupun non-B3 yang telah dibuat oleh BRMS dapat dilihat melalui bagan berikut: (306-2) (POJK51-F.14)

In the gold mining industry, waste management is a crucial aspect of environmental compliance and operational sustainability. Waste is categorized into operational and domestic waste. Operational waste, such as used oil, oil filters, and chemical residues from heavy equipment maintenance and minor construction work, is generally classified as hazardous waste (B3). Meanwhile, domestic waste comes from daily project activities, including office operations, canteens, and worker housing, consisting mostly of organic and inorganic waste. To minimize environmental impact, waste management is carried out by implementing the 3R principles (Reduce, Reuse, Recycle).

# Pemanfaatan Tailing Kering

CPM menjadi perusahaan pertambangan emas pertama di Indonesia yang membangun Dry Tailing Management Facility (DTMF) sebagai upaya BRMS dalam mencegah dampak lingkungan perusahaan yang diakibatkan oleh limbah tailing. Pembangunan DTMF yang telah selesai pada 2024 ini telah mengikuti standar yang tercantum dalam Peraturan Menteri LHK No. 6 Tahun 2021 tentang Tata Cara dan Persyaratan Pengelolaan Limbah B3.

Dengan penerapan teknologi filtrasi di unit filter press, kami menghasilkan tailing kering dengan kandungan padat mencapai 80%, yang kemudian disimpan di Waste Pile yang memiliki izin resmi. Air hasil proses filtrasi tersebut dikembalikan ke pabrik pengolahan dalam sebuah sistem yang tertutup (Closed-Circuit). Keuntungan utama dari sistem ini adalah pengurangan signifikan dalam penggunaan air, sianida, kapur dan merecover logam emas yang masih ada terkandung dalam air tersebut.

# Utilization of Dry Tailings

CPM became the first gold mining company in Indonesia to build a Dry Tailings Management Facility (DTMF) as an effort by BRMS to prevent the company's environmental impact caused by tailings waste. The construction of the DTMF, which has been completed in 2024, has followed the standards stated in the Minister of Environment and Forestry Regulation No. 6 of 2021 concerning Procedures and Requirements for Hazardous Waste Management.

With the application of filtration technology in the filter press unit, we produce dry tailings with a solid content of up to 80%, which are then stored in a Waste Pile that has an official permit. The filtration process water is returned to the treatment plant in a closed-circuit system. The main advantage of this system is the significant reduction in the use of water, cyanide, and lime, while also recovering gold metals that are still contained in the water.

BRMS and its business units and its business units are committed to implementing the mitigation hierarchy, which includes avoiding ecosystem disturbances, minimizing impacts, and restoring and compensating for any damage. A key approach is post-mining land rehabilitation, carried out in stages by restoring topography and reintroducing native vegetation to support habitat regeneration. The company also applies biodiversity-based revegetation, planting local species that enhance soil fertility and sustain the food chain. Through sustainable mining practices, the company not only complies with environmental regulations but also ensures long-term positive impacts on the ecosystem and surrounding communities.

Some of our operational areas are located in or adjacent to protected status areas such as CPM which is currently in Block I Poboya. This block is located in the area of Protected Forest (HL), Limited Production Forest (HPT), Grand Forest Park (Tahura) and Other Use Areas ("APL"). CPM carries out the construction of mining facilities including mining infrastructure, processing plants and other supporting facilities in parts of the HPT and APL areas.

Mining operations are currently in Block I Poboya. Block I Poboya is located in a protected forest area, Limited Production Forest, Grand Forest Park (Tahura) and Other Use Areas (APL). Part of the construction of mining facilities takes place at APL (mining infrastructure, processing plants and other supports) while mining is carried out at HPTs that have received PPKH OP. The planned copper mining and processing activities in Block I of the Sungai Mak Complex have the potential to significantly impact biodiversity, including fauna migration, species invasion, and a decline in biodiversity. To understand the baseline conditions before operations commence, G has conducted various biodiversity studies, including an Environmental Impact Assessment (AMDAL) in 2018 and biannual aquatic biota monitoring. Through these studies, G has identified activity sources that may affect the diversity of flora, terrestrial fauna, and aquatic ecosystems, with the following activities:

- Preparation and maturation of mining and processing construction sites.
- Construction of facilities and infrastructure for mining and processing activities.
- Mining land clearing.
- Reclamation and post-mining.

In 2024, GM has cleared 43.33 Ha of land for supporting facilities such as non-mine roads, employee housing, offices, workshops, drillpad, drilling access, fuel station, and nursery in preparation for construction activities that have been carried out land stewardship to prevent landslides. Aiming to support revegetation activities in the land clearing area, GM has built the Tombulilato Nursery to nurture local plants, cover crops, and fast-growing plants. The provision of seedlings is carried out independently by taking seedlings from the land clearing area and through cooperation with local vendors CV Forest Modelidu and Kebut Bibit Desa ("KBD") Mopuya owned by BP DAS Gorontalo Province.

Our management strategy involves the installation of signage prohibiting the hunting of wildlife, the prohibition of tree logging activities, along with the monitoring of flora and fauna at various sampling locations within the protected forest area.

07

Kegiatan konstruksi pertambangan saat ini berada di Prospek Anjing Hitam. Prospek ini berada pada area kawasan hutan lindung ("HL") dan Area Penggunaan Lain ("APL"). Pembangunan sarana-prasarana pertambangan dibangun di HL dan APL. Sarana prasarana pertambangan yang akan dibangun pada HL, antara lain Portal, Pabrik atas, Gudang Handak, Pabrik bawah, Camp Tambang, Sedimen Pond. Sedangkan sarana-prasarana yang akan dibangun di APL yaitu TSF (Tailing Storage Facility).

Pemantauan fauna di DPM dilakukan dengan menggunakan alat monitoring camera trap setiap 2 bulan sekali. Pengambilan data fauna dari camera trap pernah dilakukan dengan pendampingan langsung oleh BKSDA. Pemantauan biota air dilakukan oleh Pihak Ketiga (PT Shafera Enviro Lab) yang sudah berakreditasi KAN di 6 (enam) titik lokasi area DPM dengan rata-rata hasil Indeks Keanekaragaman (H') pada bulan Agustus 2024 sebagai berikut:

LSW=2,995; LSIR=2,899; LSB=2,971; LMS=2,874; LBG-02=2,959; LSG=2,838), dan pemantauan benthos: LSW=2,64; LSIR=2,65; LSB=2,77; LMS=1,90; LBG-02=2,20; LSG=2,90).(POJK51-F.10)

PT GM telah melakukan pemantauan fauna sebanyak 2 (dua) kali di tahun 2024 sesuai dengan Dokumen RKL-RPL. Jenis fauna yang ditemukan antara lain burung sebanyak 15 (lima belas) spesies, mamalia sebanyak 6 (enam) spesies, reptil dan amfibi sebanyak 3 (tiga) spesies, serta serangga dan invertebrata sebanyak 3 (tiga) spesies. Dari hasil pemantauan ini, terlihat bahwa keanekaragaman fauna di wilayah kerja PT GM masih cukup tinggi. Oleh karena itu, PT GM berkomitmen untuk terus melakukan pemantauan rutin dan menerapkan langkah-langkah mitigasi gunya meminimalkan dampak terhadap keberlanjutan fauna di area kerja. Langkah yang dilakukan yaitu dengan melakukan pelepasan satwa liar pada area yang telah ditetapkan, seperti satwa liar yang ditemukan seperti musang, ular, kadal, dan lain-lain.

Mining construction activity is currently on the Anjing Hitam Prospect. This prospect is located in the protected forest area ("HL") and the Other Use Area ("APL"). Mining facilities and infrastructure were built in HL and APL. Mining infrastructure facilities to be built at HL include Portal, Upper Factory, Handak Warehouse, Lower Factory, Mining Camp, Sediment Pond. Meanwhile, the infrastructure that will be built at APL is the TSF (Tailing Storage Facility).

Fauna monitoring at DPM is conducted using camera trap every 2 months. Fauna data collection from camera traps was previously carried out with direct assistance from the BKSDA. Water biota monitoring is conducted by a Third-Party (PT Shafera Enviro Lab), accredited by KAN, at 6 locations within the DPM area. The average results of the Diversity Index (H') in August 2024 are as follows:

LSW=2,995; LSIR=2,899; LSB=2,971; LMS=2,874; LBG-02=2,959; LSG=2,838. Benthos monitoring results are: LSW=2,64; LSIR=2,65; LSB=2,77; LMS=1,90; LBG-02=2,20; LSG=2,90)

PT GM has conducted fauna monitoring 2 (two) times in 2024 in accordance with the RKL-RPL Document. The types of fauna found include 15 (fifteen) species of birds, 6 (six) species of mammals, 3 (three) species of reptiles and amphibians, and 3 (three) species of insects and invertebrates. From the results of this monitoring, it can be seen that the fauna diversity in the PT GM work area is still quite high. Therefore, PT GM is committed to continuing to conduct routine monitoring and implement mitigation measures to minimize the impact on the sustainability of fauna in the work area. The steps taken are by releasing wildlife in designated areas, such as wildlife found such as civets, snakes, lizards, and others.

# MEKANISME PENANGANAN KELUHAN TERKAIT LINGKUNGAN

Environmental Complaints Handling Mechanism (2-27) (POJK51-F.15) (POJK51-F.16)

BRMS dan unit usaha berkomitmen untuk mematuhi seluruh peraturan dan perundang-undangan yang berlaku terkait lingkungan hidup sebagai bagian dari tanggung jawab operasional dan keberlanjutan. Kepatuhan ini tidak hanya memastikan kelancaran operasional, tetapi juga mendukung pencapaian kinerja keberlanjutan dalam aspek ekonomi, lingkungan, dan sosial. Kami juga mendorong keterlibatan seluruh pemangku kepentingan dalam proses perbaikan berkelanjutan, khususnya terkait keselamatan pertambangan dan perlindungan lingkungan. Partisipasi ini dilakukan melalui berbagai saluran, termasuk media massa, dialog dengan komunitas, serta kegiatan stakeholder engagement lainnya.

Lebih lanjut, setiap unit usaha telah menyusun sebuah mekanisme penanganan keluhan melalui prosedur tentang Komunikasi, Konsultasi dan Partisipasi nomor GM-HSE-PR-008. Dengan menggunakan prosedur tersebut, para pemangku kepentingan dapat menyampaikan keluhan, temuan, ataupun berkonsultasi dengan PIC yang ditunjuk mewakili perusahaan yaitu External Manager dan Community Liaison Officer (CLO). Lebih lanjut, di CPM, seluruh keluhan masyarakat atau pihak berkepentingan lainnya terkait lingkungan hidup dapat disampaikan tertulis kepada kelurahan/ kecamatan, dinas lingkungan hidup Kota Palu, Provinsi Sulawesi Tengah.

Selama tahun 2024, kami menerima beberapa pengaduan terkait isu lingkungan dan dampaknya terhadap masyarakat di sekitar beberapa unit bisnis kami. Seluruh kegiatan penambangan, termasuk yang saat ini sudah beroperasi di CPM telah dilakukan berdasarkan izin resmi dari pemerintah dan mengikuti prinsip-prinsip good mining practice.

Kami menghargai setiap keluhan atau pengaduan yang kami terima sebagai kesempatan untuk perbaikan, sambil tetap memastikan perlindungan dan kebebasan bagi para pelapor serta tidak menghambat partisipasi publik dalam kegiatan operasional kami. Hingga akhir tahun 2024, kami masih terus berdialog dengan pemerintah setempat, dinas lingkungan, perwakilan masyarakat, dan para ahli untuk menyelesaikan keluhan yang diajukan dengan tujuan mencapai solusi yang berkelanjutan dan bermanfaat bagi semua pihak.

BRMS and its business units are committed to complying with all applicable environmental regulations and laws as part of their operational responsibility and sustainability efforts. This compliance not only ensures smooth operations but also supports the achievement of sustainable performance in economic, environmental, and social aspects. We also encourage the active involvement of all stakeholders in the continuous improvement process, particularly in mining safety and environmental protection. This participation is facilitated through various channels, including mass media, community dialogues, and other stakeholder engagement activities.

Furthermore, each business unit has developed a mechanism for handling complaints through procedures regarding Communication, Consultation and Participation number GM-HSE-PR-008. By using this procedure, stakeholders can submit complaints, findings, or consult with the PIC appointed to represent the company, namely the External Manager dan Community Liaison Officer (CLO). Furthermore, at CPM, all complaints from the community or other interested parties related to the environment can be submitted in writing to the sub-district, sub-district, environmental office of Palu City, Central Sulawesi Province.

Throughout 2024, we received several complaints related to environmental issues and their impacts on communities surrounding some of our business units. All mining activities, including those currently operating in CPM, have been conducted under official government permits and in accordance with good mining practice principles.

We view each grievance as a valuable opportunity for improvement, maintaining our commitment to safeguarding whistleblowers' rights and fostering unhindered public participation in our operational endeavors. Throughout the remainder of 2024, we remain dedicated to engaging in constructive dialogue with local authorities, environmental bodies, community representatives, and subject matter experts. Our objective is to collaboratively address the grievances raised to ensure sustainable and mutually beneficial outcomes.

# Independent Assurance Statement

Report No. 0425/BD/0019/JK

## To the Management of PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk,

We were engaged by PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk ('BRMS') to provide assurance with respect to BRMS's Sustainability Report 2024 ('the Report'). The assurance engagement was conducted by a multidisciplinary team with relevant experience in sustainability reporting.

## Independence

We carried out all our assurance undertakings with independence and autonomy having not been involved in the preparation of any key part of the Report, nor did we provide any services to BRMS during 2024 that could conflict with the independence of the assurance engagement.

## Assurance Standards

Our work was carried out in accordance with ISAE3000 'Assurance Engagements other than Audits or Reviews of Historical Financial Information' issued by the International Auditing and Assurance Standards Board. This standard requires that we comply with ethical requirements and plan and perform the assurance engagement to obtain limited assurance.

## Level of Assurance

By designing our evidence-gathering procedures to obtain a limited level of assurance based on ISAE3000, readers of the Report can be confident that all risks or errors have been reduced to a very low level, although not necessarily to zero.

## Scope of Assurance

The scope of our work was restricted to the following selected information:

- Environmental management
- Occupational health and safety
- Community development

## Responsibility

BRMS is responsible for the preparation of the Report and all the information and claims therein, which include established sustainability management targets, performance management, data collection, etc. In performing this assurance engagement, our responsibility to the management of BRMS was solely for the purpose of verifying the statements it has made in relation to its sustainability performance, specifically as described in the selected information, and expressing our opinion on the conclusions reached.

## Methodology

In order to assess the veracity of certain assertions and specified data sets included within the Report, as well as the systems and processes used to manage and report them, the following methods were employed during the engagement process:

- Review the Report, internal policies, documentation, management and information systems
